meta.parties: Samaraweera Et Al. v. Mohotti Et Al

rules.statement: The defendant is clearly bound to remove the encroachments, and should be ordered to do so without substantially impairing the use of the house.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think that the defendant should be condemned to remove the encroachments at D, E, F, G, and M, and to surrender possession of H to the plaintiffs, and to pay the plaintiffs costs, in both Courts"
